view: As the viewer sees a right-handed signer: right hand on the viewer's left.
note: Dwibon data stores each hand relative to its own wrist, so in two-handed letters from that set (all but H, J, Y) the hands are placed side by side with a fixed gap: their relative position is schematic, the tip says how they touch. H, J and Y come from photos and keep the real placement.

letters.tip: Both fists with thumbs up, thumb tips touching like a peak.
Both hands make a ring with thumb and index; the rings touch, other fingers up.
One hand curves thumb and index finger into a C.
One index points up; the other thumb and index curve against it to make a D.
One hand makes a C with thumb and index; the other index points into it.
Index and middle fingers of one hand lie across those of the other hand.
Both hands in fists, one fist stacked on top of the other.
Flat hand brushes across the palm of the other, open hand.
Index finger points to and touches your own chin.
One hand makes an L, thumb up; the other index traces along it up to the thumb tip.
One index points up; the other hand's bent fingers touch its middle, like a K.
Index finger up and thumb out to the side, making an L.
Three fingers of one hand rest on the palm of the other, open hand.
Two fingers of one hand rest on the palm of the other, open hand.
Thumb and index fingertip touch to make a ring, like an O.
One index points up; the other thumb and index make a loop at its tip, like a P.
One thumb and index make a ring; the other index points into it like a tail.
Bent index finger of one hand rests on the palm of the other hand.
Both hands in fists, little fingers hooked together.
One index points up to touch the other, sideways index, making a T.
Thumb and index finger point up, curved apart like a U.
Index and middle fingers up and apart in a V.
Fingers of both hands interlocked, crossing like a W.
Both index fingers crossed to make an X.
One thumb and index spread in a V; the other index touches the fork and moves down.
One flat hand stands upright; the other flat hand's fingertips touch it sideways.

numbers.tip: All fingertips curve round to meet the thumb, making an O.
numbers.note: Same O handshape as ASL 0 (ISLRTC numbers chart); drawn from ASL-HG.

numbers.tip: Index finger up; other fingers folded under the thumb.
Index and middle fingers up in a V.
Index, middle and ring fingers up; thumb holds the little finger.
Four fingers up, thumb folded across the palm.
Open hand, all five fingers spread.
Little finger up; thumb across the other folded fingers.
Index finger up and bent over at the top; other fingers in a fist.
Thumb, index and middle fingers out; ring and little fingers folded.
Fist turned sideways with the thumb pointing down.
